purpose: Preserve the async QA / candidate-version / non-blocking verification ideas from the current Primary Chat design cycle without creating promotion authority parallel to CURRENT.

ideas.name: ASYNC_QA_NON_BLOCKING_DELIVERY
ideas.summary: QA should not unnecessarily block a usable candidate/result. Publish or expose the candidate according to existing safety/promotion rules while verification continues asynchronously when the change is reversible and policy allows it.

ideas.name: QA_PENDING_VISIBLE_STATE
ideas.summary: Primary Chat/widget should visibly distinguish a candidate that is usable but still under verification, e.g. QA_PENDING, from VERIFIED, REPAIR_REQUIRED, BOUNDARY and PROMOTION_READY. The human should not need to ask whether QA is still running.

ideas.name: VERSION_CANDIDATE_LANE
ideas.summary: Workers may prepare a successor candidate version while the current usable version remains available. Candidate work must be isolated/reversible and must not silently replace CURRENT.

ideas.name: QA_TO_AUTOMATIC_REPAIR_SUCCESSOR
ideas.summary: When QA finds bounded defects, its return should be consumable by Guide/Integrator to materialize repair successors automatically instead of waiting for the human to act as courier.

ideas.name: PROMOTION_READY_HUMAN_NOTIFICATION
ideas.summary: When a candidate and its QA evidence satisfy the existing promotion gate, Primary Chat can show one explicit notification/action such as ACTUALIZAR/PROMOVER with concise reasons and evidence. The button is a projection/action surface, not promotion authority.

ideas.name: QA_FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION
ideas.summary: Verifier returns should separate PASS, COSMETIC_OR_LOW_RISK_FIX, REPAIR_REQUIRED, REGRESSION, CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY and HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED so low-risk repairs can continue without blocking everything.

ideas.name: EARLY_QA_PREPARATION
ideas.summary: Acceptance cases, fixtures, click paths, visual references, browser checks and regression targets should be prepared while implementation is still running when dependencies permit, reducing post-implementation idle time.

ideas.name: QA_PARALLEL_PYRAMID
ideas.summary: A producer can fan out into independent static/contract/browser/visual/E2E/adversarial checks, followed by judge/integration. Capacity surplus should preferentially fill grounded verifier/critic/recovery lanes rather than duplicating producers.

ideas.name: CURRENT_VERSION_STAYS_USABLE_DURING_CANDIDATE_QA
ideas.summary: Do not make the human wait for verification of a successor when a known-good CURRENT version can remain usable. Candidate QA and repairs proceed beside it; only existing authority decides promotion.

ideas.name: QA_PROGRESS_AS_WIDGET_DATA
ideas.summary: Expose deterministic QA status when the data exists: candidate version/ref, checks total/completed/passed/failed, last verifier signal, blockers, repair successor status and promotion readiness. Use AI only to summarize ambiguous findings.

ideas.name: REAL_INTERACTION_VERIFICATION
ideas.summary: For UI artifacts, QA must prove served behavior, not merely source correctness: render/load, click/tap paths, visual state, persistence/transport effects and relevant cross-device/browser behavior where required.

ideas.name: QA_MUST_NOT_BECOME_SERIAL_TAX
ideas.summary: Planner must decide which checks are blocking vs asynchronous vs post-release observation, based on reversibility, privacy/security risk, authority impact and user-facing blast radius. Not every check belongs on the critical path.

candidate_flow: CURRENT_USABLE -> CANDIDATE_READY -> QA_PENDING -> {VERIFIED | LOW_RISK_REPAIR | REPAIR_REQUIRED | BOUNDARY} -> repair successors as needed -> PROMOTION_READY -> existing promotion authority/human gate where required
planner_questions_to_reuse: What must be verified before the candidate is usable, and what can run asynchronously afterward?
Which QA checks can be prepared before implementation completes?
If QA finds a bounded defect, can Guide materialize the repair successor automatically?
Can the current known-good version remain usable while a candidate is being verified?
What exact evidence makes the candidate promotion-ready?
Which QA result requires a human decision rather than automatic repair?
truth_boundary: This index does not create release/promotion authority, a second QA scheduler, or a new CURRENT. Implementation must reuse existing validator/judge/verification/promotion owners and preserve rollback.
